children.name: background_image
children.description: Full-width hero background behind the thank-you headline.

children.name: headline
children.description: Primary thank-you headline centered over the hero (e.g. after form submit, download, or booking).

children.name: headline
children.description: Left-column subheading after the hero (e.g. that an expert will follow up soon).

children.name: body
children.description: Left-column body copy: what happens next, how to reach the team, optional bullet-style expectations for a meeting or download follow-up. May include list-style guidance for AI.

children.name: region_label
children.description: Region or territory line above the contact name (e.g. USA and Canada).

children.name: full_name
children.description: Contact person full name on the card.

children.name: department
children.description: Job title or department under the name (e.g. Sales).

children.name: portrait
children.description: Square portrait image for the contact card.

children.name: phone_display
children.description: Phone number as shown on the card (human-readable format).

children.name: email_display
children.description: Email address as shown on the card.

children.name: button_label
children.description: Optional CTA label on the card when the meeting button is shown.

children.name: button_link
children.description: Destination URL for the card CTA when the button is enabled.

children.name: linkedin_url
children.description: Optional LinkedIn profile URL when social links are enabled on the card.
